title: Abinci da sayayya
description: Ten short, simple stories about food and shopping in Hausaland: the market, a food company, a cooking contest, a feast at the emir's house and more.

lessons.title: Tafiyar Kande
lessons.summary: Kande's car will not start, so she walks to the market near her house and walks back home with her food.
lessons.text:
Kande tana zama a Yola. Yau ta tashi da wuri. Tana son ta je kasuwa domin ta samu kayan abinci.

Kande tana da mota. Motarta farar mota ce. Amma yau farar motar ba ta aiki.

Ɗanta Jibrin ma yana da mota. Motar Jibrin baƙa ce. Amma Jibrin ya tashi tun da wuri, kuma ya tafi aiki da baƙar motarsa.

"Babu mota a gida," Kande ta ce. "To, zan tafi da ƙafa. Kasuwa tana kusa."

Kande ta fita daga gida. A waje akwai rana sosai. Ta yi tafiya da ƙafa. Tafiyar tana da daɗi, saboda kasuwar tana kusa da gidanta.

A kasuwa, Kande ta samu kayan abinci da yawa. Sannan ta koma gida da ƙafa. Kayan suna da yawa, amma gidanta yana kusa.

Bayan wani lokaci, sai ta ga baƙar mota a waje. Jibrin ne ya koma gida daga aiki. Ya fita daga motarsa.

"Na tafi kasuwa da ƙafa," Kande ta ce wa Jibrin. "Tafiya da ƙafa tana da kyau."

"Haka ne," Jibrin ya ce. "Ni ma zan yi tafiya da ƙafa."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Kande ta tafi kasuwa da ƙafa?
Farar motarta ba ta aiki, kuma Jibrin ya tafi aiki da baƙar motarsa.
Kasuwa tana kusa da gidan Kande?
Haka ne, kasuwa tana kusa da gidan Kande.
Kande ta koma gida da me?
Kande ta koma gida da ƙafa.
Me Kande ta gani a waje?
Ta ga baƙar motar Jibrin a waje.

lessons.title: 'Yar Saratu
lessons.summary: Saratu's little daughter gets lost in the market, and the market guard finds her in front of a food stall.
lessons.text:
Saratu tana zama a Maiduguri. Tana da 'ya ɗaya. Sunan 'yarta Amina.

Wata rana, Saratu ta tafi kasuwa tare da 'yarta. A kasuwa akwai mutane da yawa sosai. Saratu ta riƙe hannun Amina.

"Amina, riƙe hannuna," Saratu ta ce.

Saratu tana neman kayan abinci. Sai ta bar hannun 'yarta na ɗan lokaci. Bayan haka, ba ta ga Amina ba. Amina ta ɓata!

Saratu ta fara kuka. "Amina ta ɓata!" ta ce. "Ina Amina?"

Wani mutum ya zo wajenta. Sunansa Dauda, kuma shi mai tsaron kasuwa ne. "Me ya faru?" Dauda ya ce.

"Ina da 'ya ɗaya, kuma ta ɓata a kasuwa," Saratu ta ce.

"Za mu nemi Amina tare," Dauda ya ce.

Dauda da Saratu suka nemi Amina a cikin kasuwa. A ƙarshe, Dauda ya gano Amina a gaban wani wurin abinci. Amina tana kuka. "Ina mahaifiyata?" ta ce. "Sunan mahaifiyata Saratu."

Mai tsaron kasuwar ya yi mamaki. Amina ƙarama ce, amma ta san sunan mahaifiyarta.

Saratu ta zo, kuma ta riƙe 'yarta. Amina ba ta kuka yanzu.

"Yanzu komai yana da kyau," Dauda ya ce.

"Haka ne, komai yana da kyau," Saratu ta ce. "Amina, daga yau, riƙe hannuna a kasuwa."

Tambayoyi:
Wa ce 'yar Saratu?
Amina ce 'yar Saratu.
Me ya faru a kasuwa?
Amina ta ɓata a kasuwa.
A ina Dauda ya gano Amina?
Dauda ya gano Amina a gaban wani wurin abinci.
Me ya sa Dauda ya yi mamaki?
Amina ƙarama ce, amma ta san sunan mahaifiyarta.

lessons.title: Kamfanin Yakubu
lessons.summary: Yakubu starts a small food company in Bauchi, and thanks to his workers' effort it grows big.
lessons.text:
Yakubu mutum ne na Bauchi. Yakubu yana harkar abinci. A shekarar 2015, ya kafa wani kamfani a Bauchi. Kamfanin yana yin kayan abinci domin kasuwa.

Da farko, kamfanin ƙarami ne. Yana da ma'aikata uku kawai. Amma Yakubu da ma'aikatansa suna aiki da ƙarfi. Kowane mutum a kamfanin yana ƙoƙari sosai.

Saboda ƙoƙarinsu, kamfanin ya yi girma. Yanzu yana da ma'aikata 50. Kamfanin yana da girma sosai yanzu.

Kamfanin yana da ɓangarori uku. Ɓangare na farko yana yin abinci. Ɓangare na biyu yana kai abincin kasuwa. Ɓangare na uku yana harkar kuɗi.

Yakubu yana son kayan zamani. Kamfaninsa yana amfani da kayan zamani a kowane ɓangare. "A zamanin yau, dole ne kamfani ya yi amfani da kayan zamani," Yakubu ya ce.

Wata rana, Yakubu ya kira duk ma'aikatansa.

"Ƙarfin wannan kamfani shi ne ma'aikatansa," ya ce. "Ƙoƙarinku ne ya sa kamfaninmu ya yi girma. Kowane ɗayanku yana da amfani."

Ma'aikatan sun ji daɗi sosai. Sun ce, "Za mu ci gaba da aiki da ƙarfi."

Tambayoyi:
Yakubu yana harkar me?
Yakubu yana harkar abinci.
Yaushe Yakubu ya kafa kamfanin?
Ya kafa kamfanin a shekarar 2015.
Da farko, kamfanin yana da ma'aikata nawa?
Da farko, yana da ma'aikata uku kawai.
Me ya sa kamfanin ya yi girma?
Kamfanin ya yi girma saboda ƙoƙarin ma'aikatansa.
Kamfanin yana da ɓangarori nawa?
Kamfanin yana da ɓangarori uku.

lessons.title: Gasar abinci
lessons.summary: Rahila is one of five women in a cooking contest in Maradi, and the judges agree that her food is the best.
lessons.text:
A garin Maradi, an yi gasar abinci. Mata biyar sun shiga gasar. Rahila tana ɗaya daga cikin matan biyar. Rahila mace ce mai son yin abinci.

Shugaban gasar wata mace ce mai suna Lami. A ranar gasar, mutane fiye da 100 sun zo.

Lami ta ce wa matan biyar, "Kuna da lokaci har zuwa rana. Yanzu kuna iya fara shirya abincinku."

Duk matan biyar sun shirya abinci. Rahila ta shirya abincinta a hankali. Ta yi komai daidai. Ta sa mai daidai, kuma ta sa ruwa daidai.

Bayan haka, mutum uku sun ci abincin matan biyar. Abincin Rahila yana da daɗi fiye da na sauran. Mutanen uku sun nemi ƙari. "Muna son ƙarin wannan abinci," wani daga cikinsu ya ce.

A ƙarshe, Lami ta bayyana sakamakon gasar. Mutanen uku sun yarda cewa abincin Rahila ne mafi kyau. Rahila ce ta yi nasara a gasar!

Sakamakon ya sa Rahila ta ji daɗi sosai. "Na yi ƙoƙari sosai," ta ce. Sauran matan ma sun yarda cewa abincinta yana da daɗi.

"Ku ma kuna da abinci mai kyau," Lami ta ce wa sauran matan.

Tambayoyi:
Mata nawa suka shiga gasar?
Mata biyar ne suka shiga gasar.
Me mutanen uku suka nema bayan sun ci abincin Rahila?
Sun nemi ƙarin abincin Rahila.
Mutanen uku sun yarda da me?
Sun yarda cewa abincin Rahila ne mafi kyau.
Wa ta bayyana sakamakon gasar?
Lami ce ta bayyana sakamakon gasar.

lessons.title: Taro a gidan sarki
lessons.summary: Adamu and his father go to the emir's great festival gathering in Katsina, where people sing and eat together for three days.
lessons.text:
Adamu yaro ne na Katsina. A Katsina akwai sarki. Gidan sarkin Katsina babba ne, kuma yana da tarihi sosai.

Mahaifin Adamu yana son tarihi. "Wannan gida yana da tarihin shekaru da yawa," ya ce wa Adamu.

Ranar Sallah rana ce ta addini. A wannan rana, akwai babban taro a gidan sarki. Dukkan mutanen gari suna zuwa taron.

Adamu da mahaifinsa sun je taron. A gaban gidan sarki, mutane suna waƙa. Waƙoƙin suna da daɗi. Adamu ma ya yi waƙa tare da su.

Sarkin, wato shugaban garin, ya zo taron. Ya ba dukkan mutanen abinci. Kowa ya ci abinci, kuma kowa ya sha ruwa.

"Taron nan na addini ne," mahaifin Adamu ya ce. "Amma kuma taron dukkan jama'a ne."

Mutane sun yi kwana uku suna taro. Kowane dare, ana waƙa. Da dare kuma, ana cin abinci tare. Adamu yana son dare sosai.

Bayan kwana uku, wato a ƙarshen taron, Adamu da mahaifinsa suka koma gida.

Tambayoyi:
Gidan sarkin Katsina yana da me?
Gidan sarkin Katsina yana da tarihi sosai.
Su wa suke zuwa taron?
Dukkan mutanen gari suna zuwa taron.
Me mutane suke yi a gaban gidan sarki?
Mutane suna waƙa a gaban gidan sarki.
Mutane sun yi kwana nawa suna taro?
Sun yi kwana uku suna taro.

lessons.title: Yahaya ya koma gida
lessons.summary: After a year at war, the soldier Yahaya comes home at night to his wife and old father and eats the food he loves.
lessons.text:
Yahaya soja ne. Ramatu ce matar aurensa. Sun yi aure a shekarar 2019.

Tsawon shekara ɗaya, Yahaya yana wurin yaƙi. Ramatu tana gida tare da mahaifin Yahaya. Mahaifinsa tsoho ne.

Wata rana, Ramatu ta ji labari: babu yaƙi yanzu, kuma sojoji za su koma gida. Labari ne mai daɗi. Tsohon ma ya ji labarin, kuma ya ji daɗi sosai.

Ramatu ta shirya abincin da Yahaya yake so.

Da dare, Yahaya ya zo gida. Ya ɗauki kayansa a hannunsa. Ramatu ta ɗauki kayan daga hannunsa.

"Yahaya, kana gida yanzu!" Ramatu ta ce.

"Ina gida," Yahaya ya ce. "Ba zan sake tafiya yaƙi ba."

Tsohon ya ce, "Yahaya, kana lafiya?"

"Ina lafiya," Yahaya ya ce. "Yanzu ka faɗa min labarin gida."

Ramatu ta kawo abinci. Yahaya ya ci. "Wannan abinci ya fi abincin sojoji daɗi!" ya ce. "Kawo min ruwa ma."

"Kana son ƙari?" Ramatu ta ce.

"Ina so," Yahaya ya ce. Sai ya sake cin abinci.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ce matar auren Yahaya?
Ramatu ce matar auren Yahaya.
Yahaya ya yi tsawon shekara nawa a wurin yaƙi?
Ya yi tsawon shekara ɗaya a wurin yaƙi.
Wane labari Ramatu ta ji?
Ta ji labari cewa babu yaƙi yanzu, kuma sojoji za su koma gida.
Me Yahaya ya ce game da abincin?
Ya ce, "Wannan abinci ya fi abincin sojoji daɗi!"

lessons.title: Cutar Shamsu
lessons.summary: Shamsu and five others fall ill after eating at one food place in Jos, and the health authority finds the reason.
lessons.text:
Shamsu yana zama a Jos. Wata rana, ya ci abinci a wani wurin abinci kusa da gidansa.

Bayan haka, jikinsa ba shi da lafiya. Wata cuta ta kama shi. Ba ya iya sa abinci a bakinsa. Ba ya iya shan ruwa ma.

Mutane biyar ma sun ci abinci a wurin, kuma cutar ta kama su ma. Dukkansu suna da alamun cutar iri ɗaya. Ba sa iya sa abinci a bakinsu, kuma jikinsu ba shi da ƙarfi.

Hukumar lafiya ta jihar ta ji labarin. Sai hukumar ta fara bincike. Ta yi bincike a wurin abincin.

Bayan bincike, hukumar ta gano dalilin cutar. Dalilin shi ne ruwan wurin. Ruwan ba shi da kyau.

"Wannan laifin mai wurin abinci ne," hukumar ta ce. "Bai kula da ruwansa ba."

Mai wurin abincin ya yarda cewa laifinsa ne. Hukumar ta ce ba zai sake yin abinci ba sai ya samu ruwa mai kyau.

Bayan kwana biyu, alamun cutar sun tafi. Jikin Shamsu ya samu lafiya. "Daga yau, zan kula da wurin da zan ci abinci," ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya faru da Shamsu bayan ya ci abinci?
Wata cuta ta kama shi, kuma jikinsa ba shi da lafiya.
Me hukumar lafiya ta yi?
Hukumar ta yi bincike a wurin abincin.
Hukumar ta gano dalilin cutar?
Haka ne, dalilin cutar shi ne ruwan wurin abincin.
Laifin wa ne?
Laifin mai wurin abinci ne, domin bai kula da ruwansa ba.

lessons.title: Shawarar gwamna
lessons.summary: The governor of Kaduna wants every school child to get lunch, and after a long meeting the state assembly makes it law.
lessons.text:
Mansur gwamnan jihar Kaduna ne. Jam'iyyarsa tana mulki a jihar. Gwamnan yana da wata shawara: yana son kowane yaro a makaranta ya samu abinci da rana.

A shekarar da ta gabata, yara da yawa ba su samu abinci a makaranta ba. Wasu yara ba sa iya karatu saboda babu abinci.

Gwamnan ya kai shawararsa ga majalisar jiha. Yana son majalisa ta yi doka game da abincin makaranta.

Majalisar ta yi taro. Taron ya gudana a Kaduna har kwana biyu. Yayin da taron yake gudana, 'yan majalisa sun yi magana sosai.

Wasu 'yan majalisa daga jam'iyyar gwamna sun ce, "Wannan shawara ce mai kyau." Amma wasu sun ƙi. Wani ɗan majalisa ya faɗi cewa babu kuɗi. "Jihar ta kashe kuɗi da yawa a shekarar da ta gabata," ya faɗi.

Gwamnan ya ce, "Mulki aikin jama'a ne. Yara suna buƙatar abinci domin su iya karatu."

A ƙarshe, majalisa ta yarda da shawarar. Yanzu akwai doka: kowane yaro a makaranta zai samu abinci da rana. Wasu sun ƙi da farko, amma yanzu dokar tana aiki.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ne gwamnan jihar Kaduna?
Mansur ne gwamnan jihar Kaduna.
Gwamnan yana son me?
Yana son kowane yaro a makaranta ya samu abinci da rana.
Me 'yan majalisa suka yi yayin da taron yake gudana?
Sun yi magana sosai.
Me wani ɗan majalisa ya faɗi?
Ya faɗi cewa babu kuɗi.
Me ya faru a ƙarshe?
Majalisa ta yarda da shawarar gwamna, kuma yanzu akwai doka.

lessons.title: Littafin Hafsat
lessons.summary: Hafsat writes a book of her old mother's dishes, a company prints it, and later a film is made about it.
lessons.text:
Hafsat tana zama a Niamey. Mahaifiyarta Kulu tsohuwar mace ce. Kulu tana yin abinci mai daɗi sosai.

Wata rana, Hafsat ta ce, "Mahaifiyata, ina son in rubuta littafi game da abincinki."

"To, zan taimaka," Kulu ta ce. Sai Kulu ta taimaka wa Hafsat. Duk rana, Kulu tana yin abinci. Hafsat kuwa tana rubuta yadda ake yin sa.

Littafin yana da shafi 60. A kowane shafi akwai abinci ɗaya.

Hafsat ta kai littafin wani kamfani. Kamfanin ya buga littafin. "Ina tsammani mutane za su so wannan littafi," shugaban kamfanin ya ce.

Littafin ya fito a kasuwa. Wata rana, Kulu ta ga littafin a kasuwa. "Wancan littafinmu ne!" ta ce. Kulu kuwa ta ji daɗi sosai.

Mutane da yawa suna son littafin. Wani mutum ya zo wajen Hafsat. "Ina son in yi fim game da littafinki," ya ce. "Fim ɗin zai nuna yadda ake yin abincin Kulu."

"Ban yi tsammanin haka ba!" Hafsat ta ce.

Bayan shekara ɗaya, fim ɗin ya fito.

Tambayoyi:
Me Hafsat ta rubuta?
Hafsat ta rubuta littafi game da abincin mahaifiyarta.
Littafin yana da shafi nawa?
Littafin yana da shafi 60.
Wa ya buga littafin?
Wani kamfani ne ya buga littafin.
Me Kulu ta ce da ta ga littafin a kasuwa?
Ta ce, "Wancan littafinmu ne!"
Me wani mutum yake son ya yi?
Yana son ya yi fim game da littafin.

lessons.title: Karen Nura
lessons.summary: Nura and Sadiya cook for their sick mother, but their dog eats the food, so they make it again.
lessons.text:
Nura da Sadiya yara ne a Agadez. Mahaifiyarsu ba ta da lafiya, kuma tana ɗakinta.

"Mu yi mata abinci," Nura ya ce. "Na san abin da take so."

Sun yi shiri. Bisa ga shirinsu, Nura zai je kasuwa, Sadiya kuma za ta shirya abincin.

Nura ya je kasuwa. Ya samu kayan abinci, kuma ya biya kuɗinsu. Sannan ya koma gida. Sadiya ta shirya abincin da mahaifiyarsu take so.

Sai suka bar abincin a wani ɗaki, suka je ɗakin mahaifiyarsu. "Mun shirya abinci mai daɗi," Sadiya ta ce.

Amma da suka koma ɗakin, babu abinci! Karensu ya ci duk abincin.

"Karen nan ya ci mana abinci!" Nura ya ce.

Mahaifiyarsu ta zo, ta ga karen. "Ba laifinku ba ne," ta ce. "Laifin kare ne."

"Me muka yi?" Sadiya ta ce. "Mun bar abincin a ɗakin da karen yake shiga. Da muka koma ɗakin, babu abinci."

Sai Nura ya sake zuwa kasuwa, kuma ya sake biyan kuɗi. Bisa ga sabon shirinsu, Sadiya ta riƙe abincin a hannunta har mahaifiyarsu ta ci.

"Abincin yana da daɗi," mahaifiyarsu ta ce. "Ku sake yi mana abinci wani lokaci."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Nura da Sadiya suka yi abinci?
Mahaifiyarsu ba ta da lafiya.
Wa ya ci abincin?
Karensu ne ya ci abincin.
Me Sadiya ta yi bisa ga sabon shirinsu?
Ta riƙe abincin a hannunta har mahaifiyarsu ta ci.
